name: jaeger
description: Jaeger v2, an open source, end-to-end distributed tracing platform based on OpenTelemetry Collector. This all-in-one configuration combines the collector, query, and UI components in a single process, using transient in-memory storage for trace data. https://www.jaegertracing.io/

ports.name: Container Port 1
ports.description: Jaeger UI and query API for viewing traces.

ports.name: Container Port 2
ports.description: OTLP gRPC receiver for ingesting trace data from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

ports.name: Container Port 3
ports.description: OTLP HTTP receiver for ingesting trace data (Protobuf or JSON) from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

ports.name: Container Port 4
ports.description: Serves remote sampling configuration to Jaeger clients.

ports.name: Container Port 5
ports.description: Zipkin-compatible endpoint for accepting spans in Zipkin v1/v2 format.
